senses.gloss: f. (= חָלוּט, v. חָלַט I) a paste made of flour stirred in boiling water, dumpling.
units: Ḥall. I, 6; Y. ib. 58ᵃ top ח׳ קמח לתוך חמין ḥălitah is flour put into hot water, contrad. to מעיסה which is חמין לתוך קמח (v.
<cite ref="Tosefta Challah 1:1">Tosef. ib. I, 1</cite>); <cite ref="Pesachim 37b:2">Pes. 37ᵇ</cite> (Ms. O. <he>החלטה</he>; v. vers. in Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6); Y. ib. II, 29ᶜ.—
